# realized through

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:realizedThrough`](gmeow-realizedThrough.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/realizedThrough>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) to an [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) that realizes it. Non-functional: a [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) may have many Expressions (translations, arrangements, narrations). Inverse of [`gmeow:realizes`](gmeow-realizes.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) -> [`gmeow:Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:realizedThrough`](gmeow-realizedThrough.md) from [`gmeow:Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) to [`gmeow:Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md), [`gmeow:Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for Work-rooted traversal down to its realizations — enumerating the translations, arrangements, and narrations of one abstract [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting this directly when modelling from the [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) up — prefer [`gmeow:realizes`](gmeow-realizes.md) and read this inverse — and avoid it for editions of an [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) (that is [`gmeow:embodiedIn`](gmeow-embodiedIn.md)).

### How to use

- Prefer asserting [`gmeow:realizes`](gmeow-realizes.md) from each [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) and read [`gmeow:realizedThrough`](gmeow-realizedThrough.md) by inversion; reach for it explicitly only in Work-rooted projections.

### Examples

- ex:hamlet [`gmeow:realizedThrough`](gmeow-realizedThrough.md) ex:hamletGermanTranslation.
